fr_boucler_verb.why: Boucle = buckle (or curl) → boucler = to buckle, to fasten; the mime fastens the buckle. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_tousser_verb.why: 'TOUPEE' ≈ tousser = to cough; the cough blows the toupee up. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_eriger_verb.why: Erect / ériger sound alike → ériger = to erect, put up; the mime raises the pole upright. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_concentrer_verb.why: Concentrate → se concentrer = to concentrate; '-TRAY' ending, he stares at the tray. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (se). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_assimiler_verb.why: Assimilate → assimiler = to absorb, assimilate; the sponge takes it all in. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_maigrir_verb.why: 'MEAGER' ≈ maigre (thin) → maigrir = to slim, get thinner. Regular -ir (nous maigrissons): GREEN beret.

fr_vaciller_verb.why: Vacillate → vaciller = to waver, to flicker; the flame wobbles in the breeze. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_dechirer_verb.why: The rip in the pants → déchirer = to tear, rip. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_sacrifier_verb.why: Sacrifice → sacrifier = to sacrifice, give up; the mime gives up his sandwich. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_abimer_verb.why: 'a-BEE-MAY' ≈ abîmer = to damage, spoil; the bee spoils the cake. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_peiner_verb.why: Peine = pain, effort → peiner = to struggle, toil. Regular -er: RED beret. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (peh-NAY -> pay-NAY).

fr_subir_verb.why: 'SUPERB' ≈ subir = to undergo; he goes through the check-up. Regular -ir (nous subissons): GREEN beret.

fr_soulager_verb.why: Soulagement = relief → soulager = to relieve, ease; the donkey's load is lifted. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_resider_verb.why: Reside / résider sound alike; résidence = home → résider = to live, reside. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_survivre_verb.why: Sur + vivre (live on) → survivre = to survive. Like vivre, irregular: GOLD beret.

fr_evanouir_verb.why: 'A VAN-ooh!' – he swoons at the van → s'évanouir = to faint. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (s'). GOLD beret = irregular.

fr_deprimer_verb.why: Depress / déprimer → déprimer = to depress, to feel down; the mime sits glumly by the melting snowman. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_guerir_verb.why: 'CAREER' ≈ guérir = to cure, heal; the toy is made well again. Regular -ir (nous guérissons): GREEN beret.

fr_renaitre_verb.why: Re + naître (be born) → renaître = to be reborn; Renaissance = rebirth. Irregular like naître: GOLD beret.

fr_denouer_verb.why: Dé + nouer (to knot) → dénouer = to undo, untie, unravel. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_revivre_verb.why: Re + vivre (live) → revivre = to relive, live again. Irregular like vivre: GOLD beret.
